toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/components/PromptCard.tsx
@@
-      <button className="imageButton" onClick={() => onPreview(prompt)} type="button" aria-label={`Preview ${prompt.title}`}>
+      <button
+        className="imageButton"
+        onClick={(event) => {
+          event.stopPropagation()
+          onPreview(prompt)
+        }}
+        onPointerDown={(event) => {
+          if (event.pointerType === 'touch') onPreview(prompt)
+        }}
+        type="button"
+        aria-label={`Preview ${prompt.title}`}
+      >
*** End Patch
